rationale: PISRS legal gazette register is the authoritative statutory substrate for ZPlaSSIED and BS sklepi; continuously produces consolidated texts and deadlines.
EN mirror of the bsi.si supervised-entity register; useful but a sibling section of the bsi.si supervision area already monitored.
Dedicated payment-institution/EMI/AISP licensing register — core payments population source with its own change stream.
A single catalogue PDF of passporting notifications; valuable evidence snapshot but not a self-renewing feed.
Dated event stream of authorisations issued by Banka Slovenije — genuine ongoing regulatory signal, not a static page.
Explanatory licensing-procedure page under bsi.si supervision; interpretive context rather than a standalone signal producer.
EBA PSD2 register with machine-readable downloads gives SI-authorised and passported-in PSPs; best cross-border payments population source.
EU credit-institutions register is the authoritative cross-check on the SI bank population and EEA branching.
Hub index of EBA registers — mine once to enumerate the child registers, then monitor those directly.
ECB SSM supervised-entity list determines SI SI/LSI split; updated periodically and decisive for which supervisory regime applies.
ATVP investment-services register is credible and in-scope but URL check failed; re-verify liveness before approving.
ATVP pointer to the ESMA MiCA interim register; opaque URL failed verification and the ESMA register itself is the durable source.
Niche INR product register, a sibling page of the ATVP registers section; thin value and unverified URL.
AJPES PRS/ePRS is the national entity-identity backbone for deduplicating financial actors across all supervisory registers.
Openly licensed bulk PRS extract refreshed twice monthly — the practical machine-readable route to the SI entity universe.
OPSI publisher-filtered catalogue of Banka Slovenije datasets; a live, structured alternative to scraping bsi.si.
CKR infrastructure page under bsi.si; reporting-member census is useful context but data itself is non-public.
Crowdsourced Wikipedia list — low credibility and fully redundant against official registers; keep only as an informal alias aid.
One-off vendor commentary on EBA register data quality; methodological evidence, low-credibility and not a recurring feed.
Static industry guide PDF that serves as the interpretation key for passporting entries; archive once, do not monitor.
NLB IR hub continuously publishes SREP/P2R, MREL and Pillar 3 regulatory-impact disclosures for Slovenia's largest bank.
A specific Pillar 3 disclosure PDF — high-value evidence, but the IR/report library is the thing to monitor.
SEOnet is the statutory ZTFI-1 regulated-information feed; one pointer replaces per-issuer polling for listed SI financials.
OTP banka disclosure library is the richest private-bank documentary trail in SI, with continuing Pillar 3 and interim filings.
Customer T&C/fee-change notices are the earliest observable signal of regulatory-deadline-driven product change under ZPlaSSIED.
Legacy SKB annual report PDF on a domain being wound down; capture as pre-merger baseline evidence, not a live source.
Compact, high-signal Addiko customer-notice feed carrying instant-payments and other regulation-driven retail changes.
